resources.string: Compose overlay style (when XCursor is unavailable)

Linux: child apps get XCURSOR_THEME and XCURSOR_SIZE. Telos loads XCursor frames into an AWT cursor when possible; otherwise the Compose Sweet/Breeze overlay is drawn. Animated XCursor sequences are not played.
Windows: maps to stock AWT system cursors. XCursor/Plasma themes are not applied to the Win32 pointer.
macOS: maps to stock AWT system cursors. XCursor/Plasma themes are not applied to the Cocoa pointer.
